en: The Banaue Rice Terraces use the inclined plane simple machine to reduce the effort needed to farm on steep mountains.
A standard wheelbarrow acts as a second-class lever to help workers lift heavy loads with less effort.
The rough rubber soles of local tsinelas increase friction to prevent slipping on wet floors.
Sir Isaac Newton formulated the law of universal gravitation after allegedly observing an apple fall from a tree.
The Japanese Maglev train uses magnetic repulsion between the tracks and the train to eliminate friction.
Ancient Chinese sailors used a naturally magnetized lodestone spoon as the first magnetic compass to find direction.
The San Roque Dam in Pangasinan generates electricity by using the kinetic energy of falling water to spin turbines.
Alessandro Volta invented the voltaic pile in 1800, creating the world's first true electrical battery.
The James Webb Space Telescope uses infrared light to observe distant galaxies hidden behind cosmic dust.
The Las Piñas Bamboo Organ produces deep musical notes by vibrating air columns inside its bamboo pipes.
The Tiwi Geothermal Power Plant in Albay converts thermal energy from underground magma into electrical energy.
A flying Philippine eagle possesses kinetic energy from its motion and gravitational potential energy from its altitude.
